About the course

Disc Golf Pro Tour course outside of Worcester, MA. Run by Steven Dodge, Tom Southwick, Ryan Daige, Gage Benson, and staff, Maple Hill is one of the premier disc golf courses in the United States and home of the MVP Open presented by Maple Valley Plastics. The course runs through the Maple Hill Farm property, using elevation change, heavily wooded fairways, and iconic water hazards. Unique to Maple Hill are the Christmas tree nurseries that span the open fairways, making even the open shots a challenge. Though MH can challenge the best in the world, the Red, White, Blue, Diamonds and tournament Gold layouts provide an enjoyable round for any player. Truly a must-play for the avid disc golfer.

Frequently asked questions

How do I get to Maple Hill?
You can get directions to Maple Hill by clicking Get Directions, which will open your device's map application with the disc golf course location. The disc golf course is located at 42.276001, -71.895699 in Leicester, Massachusetts.
Do I need to pay to play disc golf at Maple Hill?
Yes, there is a fee to play disc golf at Maple Hill. Additional information: We are closed the Sunday before Thanksgiving to New Years for Christmas Tree Season! $12/weekdays, $20/weekends, Schedule Tee Time through maplehilldiscgolf.com Public tee times are from 9am-6pm. Before 9am it is members only so any public players will be charged $30 for early morning rounds. $5 Walker fee for those not playing For questions about pricing, contact the course: [email protected]
What is the difficulty and length of Maple Hill?
Maple Hill has 18 disc golf holes and has a difficulty rating of "Moderate", "Hard" and "Very hard". The typical disc golf round at Maple Hill takes about 2 hours and covers approximately 1.8 miles (2.9 km).
How highly rated is Maple Hill by the disc golf community?
Maple Hill has an average rating of 4.9 out of 5 stars based on 11281 community reviews. This is considered an excellent course rating by the disc golf community.
What amenities are available at Maple Hill?
Maple Hill offers the following amenities: 18 disc golf holes, restrooms, drinking water, cart-friendly paths, pet-friendly areas, stroller-friendly paths. Restroom details: 4 indoor bathrooms available during business hours! Porta potties by hole 1. Water availability: Spigot on the backside of the pro shop. Stroller access: Large wheels for gravel road.

How can I record my disc golf round at Maple Hill?
